## File: google-deepmind_alphastar/alphastar/architectures/standard/configs/full.py

Prompts

```
['get the full standard v3 architecture config dict with encoders, torso, and heads for AlphaStar', 'summarize the get_config function that returns a ConfigDict for the AlphaStar standard full architecture', 'review the get_config function to understand the encoder, torso, and head component configurations', 'refactor the get_config function to add new encoder or head component configuration parameters', 'test the get_config function to verify all config fields are set correctly', 'get the config dictionary for the AlphaStar standard lite architecture', 'customize the encoder settings for game loop, unit counts, player, and MMR in the lite config', 'modify the torso parameters including vector resnet, units transformer, scatter, and visual resnet blocks', 'adjust the head configurations for function, delay, queued, repeat, unit tags, target unit tag, and world heads', 'configure the vector, units, and visual stream sizes for the lite architecture']
```

```
{'get_config': 'get the full standard v3 architecture config dict with encoders, torso, and heads for AlphaStar', 'summarize_get_config': 'summarize the get_config function that returns a ConfigDict for the AlphaStar standard full architecture', 'review_get_config': 'review the get_config function to understand the encoder, torso, and head component configurations', 'refactor_get_config': 'refactor the get_config function to add new encoder or head component configuration parameters', 'test_get_config': 'test the get_config function to verify all config fields are set correctly'}
```
